newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close higher, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close higher, more gains seen.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks ended higher on Thursday spurred by investors who expected better third quarter corporate performances and an investor-friendly budget next month, brokers said.
"The market started with a major blast," said Sabri Marikkar of John Keells Stocks Brokers. "But it was a little too much and we saw a slight correction in the course of the day."
The all share price index broke through the 600-point pyschological barrier to end 5.3 points higher at 605.
Ruan Dayananda of Asia Capital said he felt a slow but steady rally could continue till the index reaches 630 points.
Gordon Nadesan of CT Smith Stock Brokers said investors could be driven by anticipation of improving earnings prospects and hope that the November 6 budget would benefit investors.
Turnover was a relatively thin 17.6 million rupees against Wednesday's 65.62 million as institutions were sidelined, brokers said.

Three Acre Farms Ltd rose almost 30 percent, or 6.50 rupees, to 28.50 after the company announced plans to buy a local firm owning a piggery, hatchery and retail outlets at 280 million rupees to expand its business.
